title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: A minute with each player
hook: When did you last talk with each player one on one?
intro: You talk to the team every practice.
Some players you have barely spoken to alone.
statement: One minute alone with a coach can mean a lot to a kid.
q1: Do you plan a short check-in with every player —
q2: or talk one on one only when something comes up?
q3: Which player have you talked to least?
t1: Every coach is different. But kids feel seen
t2: when their coach makes time just for them.
cta: Coaches — do you check in one on one?
ctaLines: Two players a practice. Water breaks. When needed.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
When did you last talk with each player one on one?
You talk to the team every practice. Some players you have barely spoken to alone.
One minute alone with a coach can mean a lot to a kid.
Planned check-ins or as needed. Every team is different.
Do you check in one on one? Share your habit in the comments.
